annotations.title: List campaigns a safety approval kept paused

description:
List the campaigns that approving this safety review kept paused for the lead, and whether each one is still paused or the coach already resumed it. Use it to find the enrollment to pass to luca_campaigns_enrollments_resume. The list is empty for a review that kept nothing paused.

Luca operation: GET /api/review-queue/{id}/kept-campaigns
Required scopes: review_queue:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: full_content
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_review_queue_kept_campaigns
title: List campaigns a safety approval kept paused
